name: Assembly-Worker, Enchanted River's Grasp — a name word followed by "creature" is a type, not the card
notes: Memory: project_audit_vocabulary_that_player_defending_player_2026-10-19. _replaceProperNounSelfRef turned 'Target Assembly-Worker creature' into 'Target this card creature' (the full name is the creature type), Blinkmoth Nexus's 'a 1/1 Blinkmoth artifact creature' likewise, and Enchanted River's Grasp's first word made 'Enchanted creature loses all abilities' a global 'this card creature' (and a stray 0/0). A name word directly followed by creature / permanent / token is left as it is.
